content.short: Revel.xyz is a social platform for creating, collecting, and trading personal media collectibles.
content.description: Revel.xyz is a social collectibles platform that combines personal media with a built-in marketplace. Anyone can design their own digital collectibles, collect others, trade, and earn, all within an end-to-end experience from creation through discovery and sharing. Upload your videos and photos, or craft new content with AI text-to-art, turning them into digital collectible playing cards. The app is available on the Apple App Store and Google Play.
